You build agents, teams and workflows in the Studio. The people who need their work, in Finance, Sales or Support, do not want to build anything: they want to ask, answer when asked, and find the result. **Desk by Agentivity** is their place.

![The home of the Desk: the field to ask, what waits for you, and requests to start in one click.](images/desk-home.jpg)

## Why a Desk

- **The Studio is for builders.** It shows prompts, nodes, credentials and settings. Most colleagues should not have to see any of it.
- **The Desk shows only what is made for them.** The Solutions you publish, the questions they are asked, their conversations, and the cockpit of their department.
- **A person on a Desk seat cannot break anything.** They start Solutions and answer. They do not change an agent, a workflow or a setting.

## What a person does in the Desk

| They | How |
|---|---|
| **Ask for work** | Describe what they need in the field of the home, or type **@** to choose whom to ask. See [Ask for work and follow it](/docs/desk/ask-and-follow-in-the-desk/). |
| **Answer** | When a Solution needs a decision or an approval, the conversation waits under **Waiting for you**. See [Answer what waits for you](/docs/desk/answer-what-waits-for-you/). |
| **Find and keep order** | Search, group, pin, archive and share their conversations. See [Find and manage your conversations](/docs/desk/find-and-manage-conversations/). |
| **Start from their department** | The cockpit of a department is its starting page. See [Build a cockpit](/docs/desk/build-a-cockpit/). |

## What a builder does for the Desk

1. [Set up the Desk](/docs/desk/set-up-the-desk/): one card guides you through the first steps.
2. [Publish Solutions to the Desk](/docs/desk/publish-solutions-to-the-desk/): choose what your colleagues can start.
3. [Give the Desk your brand](/docs/desk/brand-your-desk/): name, colour, logo and a welcome line.
4. [Invite people on a Desk seat](/docs/desk/seats-and-rights-of-the-desk/): who can do what.
5. [Build a cockpit](/docs/desk/build-a-cockpit/) for each department, with its [blocks](/docs/desk/cockpit-blocks/) and its [layout and look](/docs/desk/lay-out-and-style-a-cockpit/). Some [ideas by department](/docs/desk/cockpit-examples/).

To understand how the pieces fit together, read [How the Desk works](/docs/desk/how-the-desk-works/) first.

## What you need

- A workspace with a sign-in. The Desk comes with the Pro and Business plans: not with Personal, nor with the Community edition. See [Plans and their limits](/docs/hosted/plans-and-limits/).
- At least one Solution published to the Desk.
- People invited on a Desk seat, or on a Studio seat.

## Open the Desk

The Desk is at the address of your workspace. The Studio is under `/studio` at the same address. You sign in once for both.

- From the Studio, the menu of a Solution in **Agents & Workflows** offers **Open in Desk**, and **Open the Desk** at the top of **Administration** › **Desk**.
- From the Desk, a builder opens the Studio with the switch **Desk** | **Studio** at the top of the side bar, or with **Open the Studio** in the account menu at the bottom.

## Spaces

By default the Desk shows everything in all the spaces of the person. A person who is in more than one space has, in the selector of spaces, a first choice, **All my spaces**, and their cockpits are grouped in the side bar under the name of their space.
